text: Curriculum design logic and knowledge frameworkThe civil engineering course takes "theoretical foundation - technical application - engineering practice" as its axis, integrating mechanical analysis, materials science, structural design and construction management to form a cross-scale knowledge system. For example:At the micro level: Study the relationship between the microstructure and strength of concrete through "civil engineering materials";At the macro level: Analyze the wind and earthquake resistance performance of 100-meter-tall buildings with the aid of "structural mechanics".The entire engineering cycle: from "engineering geology" investigation and site selection, to "construction organization design" planning and construction process, and then to "engineering inspection" ensuring service safety.
